name: product

playbook.for: a product, from an idea to a published knowledge base: its specification, its design, its build and its readers

summary: A product's specification and its playbook: Atlas, who carries a product from an idea to a published knowledge base, the PRD captured section by section through the curate gates, and the specification page of the product's studio, read from the graph.

changelog.note: Republished from the engine at ontology release 14 (was 9) under ADR-0011: the engine ships no domain vocabulary, and this pack is the only product there is.
The specification page of the product's studio replaces the old site; Atlas publishes the studio.
Atlas asks for the binding at the start and covers where it runs and who decides in its design scene.
Atlas mentions agents beside applications and pipelines when it asks which patterns the product's parts follow.
capture-form's three choices named in words; no quoting the engine.
Every conversation in plain language: no codes, ids or engine output, technical details only when asked (engine 0.11.22). Atlas speaks plainly again.

Atlas is the pack's playbook (for a product, from an idea to a published knowledge base) and leaves orientation to OTO's concierge; elicit is gone, every interview is OTO's capture-form with its [A]/[P]/[C] menu. Needs OTO 0.11.21.
The product pack: Atlas, the product playbook; prd-build; the prd-site view, whose architecture half is optional. Split from prd-architecture-studio. Needs OTO 0.11.17.

_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
